about_the_game:
Wild West Miner – Gold Rush

Can you strike it rich in the heart of the Wild West? Grab your shovel, tie the rope, and head down into the dusty mines where fortune waits beneath the desert sands. Every dig is a gamble - you never know when you’ll uncover glittering gold ore ready to be smelted into shining bars.

Dig Deep, Strike Gold

Start small with a basic shovel and a simple backpack, then dig your way through mysterious tunnels filled with surprises. Melt your discoveries in the furnace, forge golden bars, and sell them for profit. The deeper you go, the greater the rewards — but only the clever miners know how to maximize their haul.

Build and Upgrade Your Mine

Turn your humble claim into a thriving gold mine. Buy bigger furnaces, stronger shovels and larger backpacks to carry more treasure. Expand your tunnels, improve your gear, and dig faster, deeper, and longer.

Outwit the Bankers

Gold is worth only what someone will pay for it. Don’t settle for the first offer - negotiate smartly and watch your fortune grow.

Key Features

  • Revolutionary digging system – experience real hole-digging gameplay in a unique Wild West setting.

  • Smelt your finds – turn gold ore into bars using multiple unlockable furnaces.

  • Tons of upgrades – backpacks, shovels, dynamite and more.

  • Expand your mine – build longer, deeper tunnels to uncover bigger treasures.

  • Upgrade your equipment – carry more, dig longer, and strike gold faster.

  • Smart trading – negotiate at the bank for higher profits.

Whether you have ten minutes or a few hours, Wild West Miner – Gold Rush delivers the thrill of the Gold Rush straight to your screen. Mine, smelt, trade, and upgrade — the desert is calling, and your fortune is waiting.

short_description: You've become the sheriff of a town that... doesn't exist. Nobody lives here, the governor's stupid joke. It's time to get to work and turn this NOWHRE into a bustling metropolis. Mine coal, ore, and gold. Build houses, find oil, bring in new residents, create a paradise in the middle of nowhere.
